headline.title: French supermarket fridges get hacked into ovens
headline.quip: Attackers switched refrigeration controllers at hundreds of French supermarkets to defrost overnight, and some cases hit 50°C. Many of the controllers reportedly accepted the login “admin” with the date as the password, which is less a password than a greeting.
headline.summary: An unknown party hacked refrigeration controllers at up to 700 French supermarkets, including Intermarché, Netto, Coopérative U, Carrefour and Monoprix stores, and set them to defrost overnight. Some fridges reached 50°C within six hours, and some equipment melted or caught fire.
